solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Rui, I am still angry. The teacher made us rewrite the essay, and she would not even tell us what was wrong.
lines.pt: Rui, ainda estou bravo. A professora nos fez reescrever o ensaio e nem quis nos dizer o que estava errado.

lines.en: She made me redo mine too, but she did explain why. The argument was weak, and the conclusion made her laugh.
lines.pt: Ela me fez refazer o meu também, mas explicou por quê. O argumento era fraco, e a conclusão a fez rir.

lines.en: My ending made her smile too, but then she made me read it aloud to the whole class.
lines.pt: Meu final a fez sorrir também, mas depois ela me fez lê-lo em voz alta para a turma toda.

lines.en: That is hard. Still, her lessons make you think harder. Last term she made us compare two articles before we wrote anything.
lines.pt: Isso é pesado. Mesmo assim, as aulas dela fazem a gente pensar mais. No semestre passado ela nos fez comparar dois artigos antes de escrever qualquer coisa.

lines.en: True, but my brother says nothing makes students work like a strict teacher. Did she let you use a dictionary this time?
lines.pt: Verdade, mas meu irmão diz que nada faz os alunos trabalharem como um professor rígido. Ela deixou você usar dicionário desta vez?

lines.en: No, she made us write by hand, which was exhausting. She said it would help us remember the vocabulary better.
lines.pt: Não, ela nos fez escrever à mão, o que foi cansativo. Ela disse que isso nos ajudaria a lembrar melhor o vocabulário.

lines.en: Maybe she is right. Her stories always make me remember things I thought I had forgotten, and that is a good sign.
lines.pt: Talvez ela tenha razão. As histórias dela sempre me fazem lembrar coisas que eu achava ter esquecido, e isso é um bom sinal.

lines.en: Maybe. The deadline worries me, though. If she makes us rewrite the introduction again, I will have to stay up all night.
lines.pt: Talvez. O prazo me preocupa, porém. Se ela nos fizer reescrever a introdução de novo, vou ter que virar a noite.

lines.en: Then let us work together. I will make a list of weak points, and you can make me explain my arguments aloud.
lines.pt: Então vamos trabalhar juntos. Vou fazer uma lista de pontos fracos, e você pode me fazer explicar meus argumentos em voz alta.

lines.en: Good plan. Nothing makes an essay better than a second pair of eyes, and a bit of coffee helps too.
lines.pt: Bom plano. Nada melhora um ensaio mais do que um segundo par de olhos, e um pouco de café também ajuda.

lines.en: Deal. Come to my place at six, and I will make us dinner. After that, I promise nothing will make me complain.
lines.pt: Combinado. Venha à minha casa às seis, e eu faço o jantar. Depois disso, prometo que nada vai me fazer reclamar.

facts.label: made us rewrite
facts.sub: Make com o sentido de obrigar ou causar usa o verbo sem to: The teacher made us rewrite the essay. Her lessons make you think. Em português: “nos fez reescrever”.

facts.label: made me laugh

answers: We say “She made us to rewrite the essay”. → Falso (We say She made us rewrite the essay.)

pages.title: Rewrite the essay · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet afternoon in Atlanta. Dirk leaves the classroom. The teacher has returned the essays. Every page has red marks. Rui catches up with him. They sit on a bench.

“Rui, I am still angry. The teacher made us rewrite the essay, and she would not even tell us what was wrong.” says Dirk. “She made me redo mine too, but she did explain why. The argument was weak, and the conclusion made her laugh.” says Rui. “My ending made her smile too, but then she made me read it aloud to the whole class.” says Dirk.
